# Components Colorpickerutils

This layer contains utilities for handling stats and calculations, provides utilities for color picker operations, and handles drag-and-drop functionality for color top picks.

## Overview

It includes components for input fields, picker panels, and lists of colors, as well as utilities for drag-and-drop functionality.

## Responsibilities

- **Color Picker Operations**: Provides utilities for handling color picker operations, such as selecting and displaying colors.
- **Drag-and-Drop Functionality**: Manages drag-and-drop operations for color top picks, enhancing the interactivity of the color picker feature.

## How it works

The `ColorPicker` folder contains components for input fields, picker panels, and lists of colors, while the `Colorpickerutils` layer provides the necessary utilities for these components to function correctly.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `VITE_APP_LIBRARY_BACKEND`, `VITE_APP_LIBRARY_URL`.
- Configuration files: `packages/excalidraw/tsconfig.json`.

## Related layers

- [Project README](../../../README.md): the overview of the whole project and every layer.
- [Excalidraw](../excalidraw.md): This folder contains various utility and helper functions used throughout the Excalidraw application, including analytics tracking, drawing trails, clipboard operations, and more.
- [Actions Actionaddtolibrary](actions-actionaddtolibrary.md): Exports various action functions, registers and exports actions for exporting projects, and manages canvas actions like changing background color and zooming.
- [Actions Register](actions-register.md): Registers actions for the application, defines types for actions and their execution, and manages actions and their execution.
- [Charts](charts.md): This folder contains various chart rendering and parsing utilities for the Excalidraw project, including functions for rendering bar, line, radar, and Cartesian charts, as well as parsing spreadsheet data into chart elements.
- [Components Dialog](components-dialog.md): Defines types for chat messages and Mermaid data, exports the dialog component, and exports Island component.
- [Components App Selection](components-app-selection.md): Manages selection of elements in Excalidraw, Text field component, and Component for ellipsifying text.
- [Components Icons](components-icons.md): Exports various icons, exports IconButtonSize and IconButton components, and defines the Tooltip component, which displays tooltips.
- [Data](data.md): This folder contains AI-related data and input types for the Excalidraw software project.
- [Fonts](fonts.md): Manages font assets and descriptors for the Excalidraw editor.
- [Hooks](hooks.md): This folder contains various utility hooks used across the Excalidraw application to manage state, events, and interactions.
- [Renderer](renderer.md): Exports animation-related classes and types, exports helper functions for rendering and UI, and exports the interactive scene rendering function.
- [Scene](scene.md): Manages rendering and exporting of scenes in the Excalidraw application.
- [Subset](subset.md): This folder contains modules for font subsetting, including a main file for worker-based operations and shared code.
- [Tests](tests.md): Contains test files for various components and functionalities of the Excalidraw application, using React, Vitest, and other libraries.
